subjects.relative_size: Multiple vehicles occupying one to two approach lanes, viewed from overhead

subjects.action: Remain completely stationary behind the stop line while the signal on their approach displays red and perpendicular traffic is actively flowing through the intersection. No vehicle crosses the stop line during this phase. When the cross-street signal turns red and all perpendicular traffic has cleared the intersection box, this approach signal changes to green. The lead vehicle then begins to move first, followed sequentially by each vehicle behind with realistic reaction delays. Vehicles accelerate gradually and pass through the now-empty intersection box without conflict.

subjects.action: Flow continuously through the intersection box at steady, normal speed while their signal is green and the opposing approach is held at red. All perpendicular vehicles complete their passage and clear the intersection box fully before their signal changes to red. Once their signal turns red, all perpendicular vehicles stop behind their respective stop lines and remain stationary for the remainder of the clip. At no point do perpendicular vehicles and the queued approach vehicles occupy the intersection box simultaneously.

background_setting: A four-way signalized intersection viewed from a fixed elevated surveillance camera. Lane markings, directional arrows, stop lines, pedestrian crossings, and traffic signal heads are clearly visible throughout. Traffic signals alternate in strict phase separation: when one approach direction has a green signal, all perpendicular approaches display red and no vehicle from those directions enters the intersection box. Vehicles from different directions never occupy the intersection box at the same time. All scene geometry, camera angle, and background elements are preserved exactly. Use the provided image as the exact first frame.
